sources.entry: nh3 - Python binding to the ammonia HTML sanitizer, a fast replacement for bleach.

summary.one_liner: nh3 provides Python bindings to the ammonia Rust-based HTML sanitization library, positioned as a faster replacement for bleach.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes nh3 as Python bindings to the ammonia HTML sanitization library. It is installed with pip and its README points to separate documentation for usage. It includes a small benchmark in which nh3.clean is reported at about 138 µs versus 2.85 ms for bleach.clean on the same HTML input, which the README summarizes as roughly 20 times faster. The README itself contains only installation, a usage pointer, the benchmark, and license information, so details of the API are not visible in it.
use_cases: strip unsafe tags and attributes from user content
replace bleach in a Python project
speed up HTML cleaning in web apps
prevent cross-site scripting from rich text
stack: Rust (ammonia library, implied by the binding)
notable: Python binding to the ammonia HTML sanitizer
Benchmarked about 20 times faster than bleach in the README
Installable with a single pip command
caveats: The README defers usage details to external documentation and does not show API examples
The README describes bleach as deprecated, so it is a replacement for an unmaintained package rather than an active alternative
